changelog:
CSM 1.0.881

New options for the episode badge

• The badge is now a pill pair you can shape: purple shows the total episodes
  released, blue shows the episodes you have actually watched.
• Show Total Pill and Show Watched Pill switch each one off individually. Turning
  one off removes it completely and also skips that lookup, so it costs no data.
• Badge Style: detailed ("24 Ep") or compact (bare numbers).
• Badge Placement: next to the dub label (with a corner fallback on cards that
  have none) or always bottom-right.
• Badge Size: comfortable or compact, both one line high.
• Unknown values still show no pill rather than a placeholder, and a hidden pill
  is really removed.

New options for notifications

• Notification Types: switch individual types on or off (announcements, updates,
  tips, info, success, warnings, errors, gifts). Nothing selected means all.
• Quiet Hours: a daily window, including one that crosses midnight. During it
  nothing is shown - and nothing is lost, because a suppressed notification is not
  marked as seen and appears afterwards.
• Reset dismissed notifications: with an unmistakable confirmation and the real
  count, so previously dismissed announcements can appear again.
• High Priority Only with a selectable threshold (0/25/50/75/100), filtering on
  the feed's own priority value.

Library and search

• The library can really be sorted and filtered now: by title, date added, year,
  rating, episode count, recently watched or unwatched first, plus type and
  watched-state filters. CSM reorders the real library list and remembers the
  original order, which comes back the moment the feature is off.
• Recent searches can be pinned and removed individually, with an honest empty
  state instead of a placeholder.

Downloads

• Queue control: how many download handoffs run at once, with bounded automatic
  retry and backoff, pause/resume/cancel and an oldest/newest order.
• A failed handoff is reported as failed - never as done - and the queue sits
  behind the Wi-Fi, charging and external-downloader rules, so it can delay work
  but can never bypass one of your policies.
• A truthful summary shows how many jobs are pending, running, done or failed,
  taken from the live state.

Settings

• Search now finds every option regardless of capitalisation or umlauts, by title,
  summary and keyword, and never shows a result whose page does not exist.
• "Last changed" jumps back to the option you just flipped.
• Reset options: per section, or all CSM options at once. The confirmation states
  exactly what is cleared (appearance, theme and palette, player, navigation,
  animation, downloads, notifications, Discord, device) and what is kept (your
  parental PIN, settings sharing, Wi-Fi transfer and Tap to TV), and CloudStream's
  own preferences, accounts, downloads and media are never touched.
• "What's new" opens the real published changelog instead of inventing content.

Appearance

• More of CSM's own interface follows your palette, and CSM's own chrome now uses
  one set of design tokens (spacing, corner radius, typography, animation) instead
  of grown-together single values, so dialogs and rows line up consistently.
• Contrast on coloured surfaces is decided from the surface's luminance, so labels
  stay readable across the whole palette range.
• Option icons were replaced with icons that actually describe the option -
  previously a single generic icon sat on up to twenty unrelated options, and the
  shipped icon set grew from 328 to 396 icons.

Discord and watch party

• Optional playback marker in the Discord presence: it shows a paused marker only
  while playback is really paused and never guesses from an unobserved player.
• The watch-party room shows the real connection and TLS state, the real
  participants and the measured sync state; a divergence is only shown when it was
  actually measured, and an unknown value stays unknown.

Updates and diagnostics

• The update view reports honest states - never checked, up to date, update
  available, check failed - with the real published changelog, and never turns
  "not checked" into "up to date".
• After a download you see the verification result that was really computed; when
  it could not be verified, it says "not verified" instead of showing a tick that
  was not earned.
• The self-test reports what it checked, what passed and what was skipped, with the
  reason for every skip.

Other plugins in this repository

• Three providers could not be built at all: the build configuration compiled them
  for an older bytecode target while an inlined library call needs a newer one. All
  providers now build, and a check reports the compile status of every provider so
  this cannot go unnoticed again.
• Every provider was verified against its real site, and the results are honest:
  Aniworld, KoolTo, KoolLiveTV, PeerTube, Filmpalast, Serienjunkies,
  WaybackMachine, YouTube, RetroFlash and ProviderHealth work; YouTube had a real
  silent bug where mobile search returned nothing, and Filmpalast silently lost the
  description. CineTo, Kinox and Serienstream serve catalog and search correctly
  while playback needs the site's own captcha or verification challenge, which the
  plugin cannot solve - stated plainly in those plugins now.
• Sto was removed: s.to no longer exists, and Serienstream already serves the same
  site with a better maintained parser.
• A health check for all providers is included, reporting compile status, whether
  the site answers and whether a minimal real query works, with honest "not probed"
  rows and a failing exit code. It resolves host names through Cloudflare DNS and
  compares that with the system resolver, and it names the level that fails
  (name resolution, TCP, TLS or HTTP) instead of a bare "dead".
• A second check verifies what CloudStream's Home and Search screens need: the
  declared categories, real Home rows, real search results and the type filter,
  quick search, the plugin's options entry point and the manifest. It found and we
  fixed a nameless Home row on PeerTube and YouTube, two permanently empty
  categories on CineTo, and missing manifest fields on several providers. New
  providers inherit this check automatically.

New German providers in this release

• Xcine (xcine.online) - German film and series catalogue with categories, covers,
  descriptions and years. The catalogue and its complete title index are
  searchable; playback is not offered because the site's player only loads a
  placeholder and its stream button leads to advertising redirects.
• Burning Series - German series catalogue with more than 10,000 series, seasons,
  episodes, episode titles and the hoster list (VOE, Doodstream, Filemoon,
  Vidmoly). Catalogue and search work; playback on the site is protected by
  reCAPTCHA and VPN blocks and therefore stays off.
• AnimeToast (animetoast.cc) - German anime with search, an A-Z index of over
  1,000 German-dub entries and real hoster handoff (VOE, Filemoon, Vidmoly,
  Mp4Upload).
• IptvOrg - German live channels from the iptv-org lists (about 290 channels)
  plus the German-language list, with genre shelves and real HLS streams.
• FreeTv - public-broadcaster live streams for Germany and Austria as real HLS.
• Kinoger (kinoger.com) - German movies with catalogue, search and real playback
  from the embedded player's MP4 sources, verified end to end.
• MegaKino (megakino.ms, currently megakino24.com) - German movies with catalogue,
  search and playback through the embedded hosters; the portal asks for a short
  cookie handshake which the plugin performs automatically.
• KinoKing (kinoking.cc) - German movie catalogue with search and details;
  playback uses the hoster mirrors the site lists itself. The site's own player
  additionally requires a Cloudflare check, which is stated in the plugin.

Also verified and corrected

• The whole provider set was tested against the real sites. YouTube had a real
  silent bug where mobile search returned no results at all, and Filmpalast
  silently lost the film description - both fixed.
• CineTo, Kinox and Serienstream serve catalogue and search correctly while
  playback needs the site's own captcha or verification challenge, which a plugin
  cannot solve; that is now stated plainly inside those plugins.
• Rejected after real probing, so that no dead entry is shipped: kino.cafe (a
  Russian portal), veev.to (a file hoster, not a catalogue), filmeonline.cc (now a
  Vietnamese gambling site), streamkiste.to and hdfilme.tv (parked or seized),
  kkiste.ag (invalid TLS certificate, only a domain-parking page), and the Kinox
  mirrors kinos.to and kinoz.to, which are not an independent source.
